title: Avoid to always round the range in connectRange
body: **Summary** In the `connectRange` we always round the range even with a precision greater than 0. Now we round the range only for a precision of 0 and leave the original value in the other case. **Result** You can play with the `RangeInput` on dev-novel. **Before:** **After:**
